title: Why overriding equals alone is unsafe in HashMap
answer: Overriding only equals() makes the logical equality rule disagree with the hashing rule, so a HashMap can miss a key that the class itself considers equal. The defect is not merely performance; it can produce incorrect key retrieval because equal objects are searched in different hash locations.
